rules: PSCV-CERT binds exact source bytes, canonical admissions, semantic profile, KernelContract, selected provider identity, ProviderSecurityProfile, assumption/resource policies, target set and execution boundary.
The serializable certificate is evidence only and never recreates CheckedCoreCapability or CertifiedSource authority.
A live CertifiedSource capability is minted only from the exact live CheckedCoreCapability in the same host session.
Production generated-JS transformations consume the live CertifiedSource capability; the native checked-seed route creates the same certificate before its already-checked session authorizes emission.

Certification establishes kernel acceptance of canonical admissions produced from the exact source under the declared frontend/encoding trust boundary. It does not imply erasure, specialization or backend preservation.
